title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 9: not for Israel's righteousness, the molded calf, the broken tablets and Moses' prayer.

questions.text: About which tall people did Israel hear it said, "Who can stand before ...?"
questions.explanation: The people were great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, of whom it was said: "Who can stand before the sons of Anak?"

questions.text: Why does Yahweh drive out the nations before Israel?
questions.explanation: It is not for Israel's righteousness, but because of the wickedness of these nations, and to establish the word he swore to their fathers.

answers.text: Because of the wickedness of these nations
Because the nations were few in number

questions.text: How does Moses describe Israel in Deuteronomy 9:6?
questions.explanation: Yahweh does not give them the land for their righteousness, for they are a stiff-necked people.

questions.text: With what were the two stone tablets written?
questions.explanation: Yahweh delivered to Moses the two stone tablets written with God's finger.

questions.text: What did Moses see that the people had made for themselves?
questions.explanation: Moses looked and saw they had sinned against Yahweh: they had made themselves a molded calf.

questions.text: What did Moses do with the two tablets after he saw that the people had sinned?
questions.explanation: Moses saw that they had sinned and made a molded calf; he threw the two tablets out of his hands and broke them before their eyes.

answers.text: He hid them in a cave on the mountain
He gave them to Aaron to keep
He threw them down and broke them
He buried them under the mountain

questions.text: Besides the people, for whom did Moses also pray because Yahweh was angry enough to destroy him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, and Moses prayed for Aaron at the same time.

questions.text: Where did Moses throw the dust of the calf?
questions.explanation: Moses burned the calf, crushed it as fine as dust and threw its dust into the brook that came down out of the mountain.

answers.text: Into the Red Sea behind them
Into the fire on the altar
Into the wind of the desert
Into the brook from the mountain

questions.text: From where did Yahweh send Israel, saying, "Go up and possess the land"?
questions.explanation: When Yahweh sent them from Kadesh Barnea to go up and possess the land, they rebelled and did not believe him.

questions.text: In his prayer, which servants did Moses ask Yahweh to remember?
questions.explanation: Moses prayed: "Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob," and asked Yahweh not to look at the people's stubbornness.
